# BE-TANGO
> Argentine tango dance school in Brussels and Woluwe, Belgium. Classes for all levels. Instruction available in English, Dutch (Nederlands), and French (Français). 5/5 rating based on 151 Google reviews.
> License: RSL-1.0
> Detailed guide: https://www.be-tango.be/llms-full.txt

## English — Tango Classes
- [All Tango Classes](https://www.be-tango.be/en/tango-classes/): Overview of all class types and levels
- [Beginners](https://www.be-tango.be/en/tango-classes/beginners/): Start-to-Tango beginner course, 14 lessons, no partner needed
- [Experienced](https://www.be-tango.be/en/tango-classes/experienced/): Intermediate and advanced tango classes
- [Couples](https://www.be-tango.be/en/tango-classes/couples/): Argentine tango for couples in Brussels — no experience needed, free trial available, €195 for 14 lessons
- [Brussels Classes](https://www.be-tango.be/en/tango-classes/brussels/): Weekly classes at Rue du Marais 68, 1000 Brussels
- [Woluwe Classes](https://www.be-tango.be/en/tango-classes/woluwe/): Weekly classes at Avenue Orban 54, 1150 Woluwe-Saint-Pierre
- [Free Trial Class](https://www.be-tango.be/en/tango-classes/free-trial/): Book a free first lesson, no commitment
- [Private Lessons](https://www.be-tango.be/en/tango-classes/private/): One-on-one or couple instruction with a BE-TANGO instructor
- [Online Classes](https://www.be-tango.be/en/tango-classes/online/): Learn Argentine tango online via video
- [Workshops](https://www.be-tango.be/en/tango-classes/workshops/): Intensive tango workshops and special themed sessions

- [Team Building](https://www.be-tango.be/en/tango-classes/team-building/): Tango team building activities for companies in Brussels

## Key Facts
- Founded: 2007
- Instructors: Professional Argentine tango instructors, teaching since 2007
- Languages: English, French (Français), Dutch (Nederlands)
- Locations: Rue du Marais 68, 1000 Brussels (city centre) and Avenue Orban 54, 1150 Woluwe-Saint-Pierre
- Beginner course: Start-to-Tango — 14 lessons, €195 per person, no partner or experience required
- Free trial class available at both locations
- Google rating: 5/5 based on 151 reviews
- Tango styles taught: Argentine tango (milonguero, salon, nuevo)
- Phone: +32 498 39 29 39
- Email: info@be-tango.be
- Website: https://www.be-tango.be
